name: Tuyen Lam Lake
summary: Boat or walk the pine shore of Tuyen Lam, the reservoir south of Da Lat. It sits south of the centre, under the monastery hill, and it is a different lake from the one in town. The shore stop is about an hour. A boat is a separate fare, so check it on arrival. Skip it when the view from Truc Lam is enough and you do not want the water.
fee: Free to view; boats Check on arrival
getThere: Highway 20 up Prenn Pass, then left
heroCaption: Pines along the shore of Tuyen Lam Lake

notice.title: This lake is not Truc Lam
notice.body: Truc Lam is the monastery on the hill. Tuyen Lam is the water below it. A boat on the lake is a separate fare.

body: Tuyen Lam is the reservoir south of town, with pines along the water. Walk the shore, or take a boat out. It is not the lake in the centre, and it is not the monastery: Truc Lam sits on the hill above this water.

Follow Highway 20 for about 5 km up Prenn Pass, then turn left for about 1 km. The shore visit is about an hour. A boat is extra, so check the fare on arrival. Come on a clear morning, when the hills read across the water.

figures.caption: Boats at the dock, with the hills behind
figures.alt: Covered boats lined up on Tuyen Lam Lake, hills across the water

gettingThere: The lake is south of the centre. From Xuan Huong Lake, take a taxi or a motorbike if you hold the right licence. The road is Highway 20, about 5 km up Prenn Pass, then left about 1 km.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi or motorbike along Highway 20, about 5 km up Prenn Pass, then left about 1 km.

legs.heading: From Truc Lam
legs.body: The monastery looks down on this lake. Come down to the shore after the halls. A boat is a separate fare.

admissionNote: The shore is free to walk. Boat and kayak hire is separate. Check the fare on arrival.
